summary_1line: Bhishma teaches Yudhishthira that righteous kings must protect subjects and that gifting land is the highest, most meritorious form of charity.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while instructing the attentive Yudhishthira about the supreme merit of gifting the earth.
A king ceremonially grants fertile land with standing crops and cattle to a humble Brahmana before gathered priests and subjects.
The Earth goddess, like a nurturing mother, rushes toward the giver of land as if blessing him with abundance.
